text:
lucy: Heads-up: onboarding sable-32k-int3 into staging. Quick smoke shows a reproducible tail "shift" when prompt contains repeated short URL fragments (~25k tokens). minimal reproducer below.

marco: repro steps?

lucy: curl repro (shortened):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"sable-32k-int3","prompt":"https://a.co/"*5000 + "END" , "max_tokens": 64}'
```

priya: interesting. deterministic across runs?

lucy: yes, reran 6x on same container: divergence at token ~25017 every time (fp16 baseline shows no shift).

cache-bot: KV-CACHE NOTICE: active_prefill_mode=buffered, prefill_window=24576, eviction_trigger=16384, last_prefill_span=25000

marco: buffered prefill > eviction_trigger looks suspicious. partial prefill could write kv entries with different absolute offsets.

priya: also check rotary-phase wrap. repeated short tokens (URLs) can create aliasing patterns in RoPE; quant noise in int3 might exacerbate it.

infra-bot: KERNEL-SELECTOR: chosen=quant-fused-remat, fallback=quant-simple, device=mi100, driver=535.113

marco: can you dump kv_offsets and rot_phase snapshot and attach to a tracker?

lucy: uploaded to BUG-2689: https://tracker.redwood/BUG-2689 (kv_offsets.bin, rot_phase.npy, kernel.log, reproducer).

priya: try forcing active_prefill_mode=atomic in staging and rerun a few samples. atomic avoids partial window writes at the cost of latency.

lucy: flipped to atomic-prefill and ran 10 trials: divergence vanished in all runs. latency p95 increased ~8%.

marco: good signal that's cache-related. next steps: 1) add regression test in model-onboard CI that primes repeated-short-token sequences up to 30k and diffs outputs across quant kernels; 2) triage if kernel ordering (fused-remat) affects numerical offsets; 3) consider short-term mitigation: enable atomic-prefill for sable canary.

priya: also schedule 100-item goldset eval comparing sable-32k-int3 vs sable-32k-fp16 and sable-24k-int8; capture mismatch-rate in the 24k-28k window.

lucy: kicked off eval job 1727004400. will post results once complete. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra per Marco's request.

marco: thanks. if goldset shows minimal quality gap, we can canary with atomic-prefill and follow up with a runtime patch to make buffered prefill write atomic-aligned windows when prefill_window > eviction_trigger.

lucy: noted. I'll update BUG-2689 with eval link and a short proposal for the runtime change.
